parsed.restated: ∀ coloring : ℂ → Fin 5, ∃ p q : ℂ, dist p q = 1 ∧ coloring p = coloring q
parsed.proof:
constructor
· intro h coloring
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  exact h ⟨coloring, fun p q hpq => hc p q (by rwa [dist_eq_norm])⟩
· rintro h ⟨coloring, hc⟩
  obtain ⟨p, q, hpq, he⟩ := h coloring
  exact hc p q (by rwa [dist_eq_norm] at hpq) he
parsed.english: For every way of assigning one of 5 colors to each point of the complex plane, there are two points at Euclidean distance exactly 1 that receive the same color.
parsed.why_clearer: It removes the bespoke ProperColoring definition and the negated existential, stating directly that every 5-coloring of the plane has a monochromatic unit-distance pair, i.e. that the plane's chromatic number is at least 6.
